_help: Fill every CHANGE-ME, then build: python3 tools/package.py channel <id>. Guide: channels/README.md section 3.
id: CHANGE-ME (same as the folder name, e.g. bodyfacts)
name: CHANGE-ME (channel name as viewers see it)
niche: CHANGE-ME (e.g. the science of the human body, explained simply)
style: CHANGE-ME (e.g. paper-craft explainers with the mascot Mia)
studio_description: CHANGE-ME (one sentence: Produces ready-to-upload <name> videos ... Use when the user asks to make, render, fix or publish a <name> video.)
script_description: CHANGE-ME (one sentence: Writes <name> scripts (<niche>) plus a publish brief ... Use when the user asks for a <name> script, ideas, hooks or titles. Does not render video.)
